purpose: positive control: can this architecture learn a known spatial weighting rule?
positions: new random 3D locations for every example, independent across train/validation/test
target: sum of each neurons mean history times exp(2*x_coordinate), normalized by weight L2 norm and scaled by sqrt(8)
model: same latent architecture as density search, 64 IDs, 8 latents, width32
budget: 20 epochs, batch64, AdamW lr0.001 weight_decay0.01, gradient clip1, validation checkpointing, one seed29
positive_gate: real test R2 exceeds each control by at least0.1; this is a strong synthetic effect, not biological effect power
